sloka: कृत्वेदं कार्मुकं सज्यं हस्तिहस्त मिवाततम् ।आकर्णपूर्णमायम्य विसृजस्व महाशरम् ॥४-११-९१॥।।
transliteration: kṛtvedaṁ kārmukaṁ sajyaṁ hastihasta mivātatam ।ākarṇapūrṇamāyamya visṛjasva mahāśaram ॥4-11-91॥।।

translations.english: 'Now string your bow, draw it like the trunk of an elephant up to your ear and release the great arrow.
